stories.title: Senedd election 2026: Polling stations open at 7am in Flintshire
stories.summary: Polling stations across Flintshire open at 7am today, Thursday 7 May, for the 2026 Senedd election. Voting will close at 10pm. Flintshire voters are split between two of the 16 new Senedd constituencies: Fflint Wrecsam and Clwyd. Fflint Wrecsam covers most of Deeside and the eastern parts of Flintshire alongside Wrexham.
